import subprocess
C='/tmp/tameshi-r17w2-CR33-HQgW7D/fleet/tameshi-shokunin'
path='corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md'
log=subprocess.run(['git','-C',C,'log','--format=%H','--',path],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
for c in log:
    p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',C,'show',c+'^:'+path],capture_output=True)
    old=p.stdout if p.returncode==0 else b''
    new=subprocess.run(['git','-C',C,'show',c+':'+path],capture_output=True).stdout
    ok = new.startswith(old) or new.startswith(old.rstrip(b'\n')+b'\n')
    print(c[:12], 'parent_rc', p.returncode, 'old', len(old), 'new', len(new), 'append_prefix', ok)
